description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role is with an organization committed to delivering outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are seeking a visionary leader who can drive operational excellence and uphold the highest standards of quality.

As the LNHA, you will be instrumental in overseeing all aspects of facility operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and enhancing the overall resident experience. This is a chance to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting, supported by a team dedicated to success.

This full-time position offers a highly competitive salary, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. Join a facility where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will directly shape the future of patient care.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong financial acumen, operational management, and team leadership abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
